about: An earlier run (run-2026-10-07-1000-migration) migrated the count line to idea-mara: the line carries its pointer, the handled list holds it with pointer [Ideas/idea-mara.md], and the unit index holds that run's b1-u1 as pointer-written. The writer adds a comment under the line asking for idea-tobias too. This run's unit has the pointer line as its source and one copy in idea-tobias. `pointers` adds idea-tobias inside the same brackets, after idea-mara, separated by ', '. The earlier run's unit index entry is untouched; this run's b1-u1 follows it as pointer-written. The real Edit guard gives [], checking only the destination added since the snapshot.
